overview.description: The Nuveen US Infrastructure ETF (NUIF) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests in infrastructure-related companies that are economically tied to the US. NUIF was launched on Jun 17, 2026 and is issued by Nuveen.

holdings.infoBox: NUIF is an equity ETF with a total of 40 individual holdings. The top holdings are American Electric Power Company stock at 8.09%, Entergy at 7.61%, Xcel Energy at 5.57%, Cheniere Energy at 4.93%, and NextEra Energy at 4.84%.
